modifications: Unrigged Tripo export in 11 parts (403,826 triangles, three 2048 px textures: base colour, metal/roughness, normal map; one double-sided material), standing on four feet facing -X. Welded across UV seams and the seams between parts (93 edges split at T-junctions, 19 pinholes filled), decimated as one mesh with the head and the crest keeping 1.6 times the share of the rest (8,702 of 37,500 triangles: head 6,352, crest 2,350), and split back into its 11 parts, closed (remake/tools/blender-decimate.py, Blender 5.2; kept as source/parasaurolophus-parts.glb, which the command reproduces byte for byte). Baked by remake/tools/bake/bake-quadruped.js with kind=hadrosaur (run with bake-character.mjs): turned to face +X, scaled to 7.5 m long (4.13 m to the top of the crest), stood on the ground with the root midway between the feet; the parts told apart by position and seams (the head holds the nose and the upper neck; the body is cut in two across the hips, so the trunk runs from the head through the front half to the half that holds the tail's tip; four legs; the crest rides the head, the two toenail parts their feet, a small patch on the back the hips); rigged with 22 bones, the neck's three joints spaced along its centre line and the head's joint at the back of the skull, under the back end of the crest's base; welded into one closed, consistently wound skin whose seams share their weights; the texture atlas redrawn so her face gets more of it (atlas=0.75: the rest narrowed to 75 % of the width, the head part's 15 islands copied from the 2048 px source into the freed column at 1.47 times their old size); the heavy brow ridges softened (brow=1, even=4: 286 vertices over the eyes smoothed along their normals and the moves evened out over the surface, by 2.8 cm at most, the eyes' outlines untouched); six clips authored in code (hadrosaur-clips.js); one skinned mesh with one matte single-sided material (roughness 0.62, no metalness, normal map at 0.5), base colour (no recolour) and normal map as 1024 px JPEG, the metal/roughness map dropped. Then the face pass and the mouth pass (below).
rig: Our bake tool for quadrupeds, with kind=hadrosaur. Bones: root, Hips, Spine, Chest, Neck, Neck2, Neck3, Head, Tail1-Tail6, and for each leg one rigid bone hanging from the root with the foot below it, named as the engine's footing plants them: BackLeg.L/R, BackFoot.L/R, FrontLeg.L/R, FrontFoot.L/R; the Jaw from the mouth pass under the Head; identity rest rotations. The neck rises from the chest (1.84 m up) to the head's joint (2.69 m up), its three joints about 0.27 m apart along its centre line; the skin follows the chain by where it lies along the line through the joints, which runs on through the head to the tip of her bill, so the whole head is rigid in front of its joint (the head's joint sits at the back of the skull, under the back end of the crest's base: the crest rides the Head bone rigidly, base and all, and her eyes are 0.64 m in front of the joint). A leg swings from a pivot on its axis (the hind legs' 2.79 m up, the fore legs' 2.19 m); the skin blends from the leg into the body between the top of the leg part and the pivot, and the body around it follows as a harmonic field. Clips: idle 5.0 s (a slow breath, the neck drifting a little, the head looking about and tilting, the tail swaying); walk 2.67 s, 2.79 m a cycle (1.05 m/s; four beats in lateral sequence, a foot down 58 % of the cycle, landing flat and sweeping back at exactly that speed; the hips and shoulders ride as high as their planted legs reach); kink 2.4 s (a friendly nod: the chin lifts, the head dips 19 degrees and then less, and comes back); happy 2.4 s (she rocks back onto her hind legs so her front feet leave the ground by up to 0.44 m, wiggles her head at the top, comes down with a soft stamp, the front feet a moment apart, and wags her tail; the clip keys the legs); eat 3.6 s (grazing: the body dips a little in front and the neck curves down until the tip of her bill is 0.12 m above the ground, 1.0 m ahead of her fore feet; the bill opens and she crops twice, then comes up chewing); call 5.0 s (her horn call through the crest: a small dip, a deep breath that fills her chest, the Spine bone growing by 6 % about its joint while the Chest shrinks back so the neck and head keep their size, the neck stretching up and the head rising 30 degrees until the crest lies back over her neck 0.13 m clear of her back, the tip of the bill 0.9 m higher; she blows: the bill opens 9 degrees, the head holds high with a gentle tremble five times a second and sways proudly while the chest empties; she settles with a little nod). eat and call carry their jaw's opening in their extras (jaw: degrees at each key), which the mouth pass turned into the jaw's tracks. Every clip loops. The feet stay planted in idle, kink, eat and call; in a scene the engine's footing plants them in walks, starts, stops and turns on the spot.
pose: Rest pose on four feet, head raised on an S-shaped neck, a long hollow crest curving back over the neck, back and tail level; faces -X; 0.98 units long, 0.54 high.
sourceTextures: three 2048 px JPEG: base colour, metal/roughness, normal map; one double-sided material
facePass: Eyes found in the colour map by remake/tools/bake/face.js (eyes.js) and written into the GLB as extras on the skinned mesh (face.eyes: per eye its centre, frame, outline and lid and lash colours, in bind space), for the eyelids the engine builds in code (engine/eyelids.js). touch=4: a dark blob merges with a pupil only when their texels come within four texels' spacing, so the dark crease under each heavy brow, close over the eye, stays apart and the outlines hold the painted eyes alone (0.23 to 0.24 m wide). The eyes are 0.70 m apart, 3.03 m up at rest. Geometry and textures unchanged.
mouthPass: A jaw cut by remake/tools/bake/mouth.js: her lower jaw belongs to the head part, so the pass splits the triangles along the crease between her upper and lower bill (the line given in the head frame, read off a gridded side view on both sides, from behind the corner of the mouth to the front of the lower bill under the upper bill's broad tip at f = 0.575) in front of f = 0.06, the corner of her smile, gives the jaw side its own vertices there (92 triangles split, 92 lip vertices opened; snap=0.001 counts vertices within 1 mm of the line as on it), adds a Jaw bone under the Head at the hinge, blends the jaw in from the hinge to the cut, fills the mouth with a pocket (palate and tongue painted into a free corner of the colour map; 1,968 triangles) and writes face.mouth.talk = 8 (degrees the jaw opens at the loudest syllable). No teeth. The clips eat and call carry the jaw's opening in their extras: the pass gave them the jaw's tracks (her bill opens 7 degrees to crop and chew, 9 to call). Re-exported with GLTFExporter (textures 1024 JPEG), node names and clip extras kept.
passes: decimateCommand, then bakeCommand, then faceCommand, then mouthCommand (the bake finds the eyes itself for the brows; the face pass writes them; the mouth pass takes its head frame from them). Rebaking from the parts reproduces the GLB byte for byte (md5 dd8bf3553813c9893290bfaee10febb6).
notes: Blue body with a darker blue stripe along the back and tail, grey-blue belly and throat, pale blue crest, amber eyes, beige toenails, a gentle duck-billed smile, as in the concept; STYLE.md section 3 takes Slóeðla's row from this model. The brows read a little heavy next to the concept's soft eye: the bake softens them (brow=1 with even=4, so the ridge's outline stays smooth on her coarse brow), and the eyelids close in a soft curve. Real adult size: 7.5 m from nose to tail tip (up to 9.5), 4.1 m to the top of her crest. Her hollow crest sounds like a horn: the call clip is her big, proud, happy call, for singing along in the reed bed in a later chapter.
